title: Training Note: Orders per Customer and One Program per Order at Ridgeline Orders & Delivery
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold any number of Ridgeline Orders & Delivery orders, each under one fulfillment program; an order mixing pickup and delivery items is split into one order per program at checkout. No maximum number of orders per customer is set.

### Questions this rule answers

**Is there a cap on how many orders one customer can have at a time?**
No. The number of orders a customer may hold has no limit.

**Can a single order run under two fulfillment programs?**
No. Every order is under exactly one fulfillment program, and the order record names that program by its official full name.

**What becomes of a basket that holds both pickup items and delivery items?**
It is split at checkout into one order per program. As an illustration, a basket holding paint to be collected in store and a refrigerator to be delivered becomes two orders: one under Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store and one under Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away. A basket that also held a box of fasteners to be shipped would become three orders, the third under Ridgeline Ship to Home.

### Input, judgement, result

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A customer already holding several orders places another | No maximum applies | The number of orders already held does not stand in the way of one more |
| A basket whose items all go under one program | One program | One order |
| A basket whose items go under two or more programs | Pickup and delivery items mixed | One order per program |

The baskets above are illustrative examples, not records of any customer.
